Reach._comment_reachCreative: How far away the player can place and break blocks. Range: 0 ~ 1000. Default: 200
Reach._comment_reachLevel0: Maximum reach in survival without upgrades Consume Power Level upgrades to permanently increase this. Range: 0 ~ 1000. Default: 0

MaxBlocksPlacedAtOnce._comment_maxBlocksPlacedAtOnceCreative: How many blocks can be placed in one click. Range: 0 ~ 100000. Default: 10000
MaxBlocksPlacedAtOnce._comment_maxBlocksPlacedAtOnceLevel0: In survival without upgrades Consume Power Level upgrades to permanently increase this. Set to 0 to disable Sophisticated Building until the player has increased their Building Power Level. Range: 0 ~ 100000. Default: 128

MaxBlocksPerAxis._comment_maxBlocksPerAxisCreative: How many blocks can be placed at once per axis when using build modes (e.g. walls). Also affects the array modifier. Range: 0 ~ 1000. Default: 1000
MaxBlocksPerAxis._comment_maxBlocksPerAxisLevel0: In survival without upgrades Consume Power Level upgrades to permanently increase this. Range: 0 ~ 1000. Default: 8

MaxMirrorRadius._comment_maxMirrorRadiusCreative: The maximum (radial) mirror radius. Range: 0 ~ 1000. Default: 200
MaxMirrorRadius._comment_maxMirrorRadiusLevel0: Maximum reach in survival without upgrades Consume Reach Upgrades to permanently increase this. Range: 0 ~ 1000. Default: 16
